summary: Frontend-only regression for the expanded 25-entry note color palette (5 solids + 20 gradients). All 9 targeted scenarios PASSED with zero console errors: palette count (25), flex-wrap layout, IndexedDB persistence for gradient names, gradient rendering on AccordionNoteItem list rows, CategoryGroup container, and FullScreenNote inner border, Batch Studio Recolor palette (25 swatches, bulk-apply lavender persists to IDB), PDF export fires a real download event with no console errors, all 5 original solids remain selectable + saved, and Batch Studio smoke (bs-move opens MoveToCategoryModal, bs-duplicate creates ' (copy)' entries, bs-delete opens confirm-bulk-delete AlertDialog with Cancel + Delete buttons).
critical_code_review_comments: NoteModal.jsx (~200 lines of JSX) and NotesApp.jsx (1443 lines) are pushing the recommended module size ceiling — consider splitting NotesApp's render branches (icon-grouped/icon-flat/list/grouped) into dedicated child components in a future refactor.
CategoryGroup winner-color selection uses simple frequency count with 'purple' fallback; ties are resolved by insertion order — acceptable but worth documenting.

getNoteColorStyle returns background+borderColor; the .note-gradient CSS class + inline style spread pattern works but relies on inline style overriding CSS — future dark-mode/hover states must be careful not to fight specificity.
seed_data_creation: Cleared IndexedDB 'IronRabbit'.notes store at start, then seeded: ColorTest(sunset), OceanN(ocean), GoldN(gold), GraphiteN(graphite), SunNote(sunset, cat=SunCat), Solid_purple/cyan/lime/pink/orange, plus 2 duplicates from bs-duplicate. All test data can be safely cleared by the same IDB clear routine.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 12 verified the 25-color palette expansion end-to-end. Key findings: (1) NOTE_COLORS in /app/frontend/src/notes/constants.js exports all 25 entries with correct testids note-color-swatch-<name>. (2) getNoteColorStyle() correctly returns {background, borderColor} for the 20 gradient variants and null for the 5 solids. (3) AccordionNoteItem, CategoryGroup, and FullScreenNote all render the inline gradient style correctly. (4) IndexedDB db='IronRabbit', store='notes' persists color as a plain string. (5) The onboarding tour reappears on every fresh session; tests must click Skip repeatedly (or clear localStorage) before hitting the FAB. (6) In list view AccordionNoteItem has no select-mode props — bulk selection only works in Icon view via NoteTile. All 25 bs-color-<name> swatches also present in Batch Studio Recolor picker. PDF export fires real download with filename 'Iron Rabbit-selected-<date>.pdf'. No console errors observed at any point.
rca of the issue: N/A - no issues found. All 9 review scenarios PASSED.
